chunks: And from him, from ʿAmmār ibn al-Mubārak, from Ẓarīf ibn Nāṣiḥ, from al-Qāsim ibn al-Walīd al-Ghifārī, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: May I be made your ransom, how many are the supererogatory prayers of the daytime?
He said: “They are sixteen rakʿahs. Whichever hours of the day you wish to pray them, you may pray them, except that if you pray them at their appointed times, it is better.”
ai.seo_question: How many rakʿahs are the daytime nawafil, and when may they be prayed?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the daytime nawafil consist of sixteen rakʿahs. It also indicates flexibility in performing them during the day, while affirming that observing their designated times is more excellent.
